column1: # CI routing (C-07) — hosted timings, before and after the split. Measured 2026-11-18 on
#   https://github.com/TomBResearch/UntitledDinosaurGame, all runs on ubuntu-24.04 with Node 24.22.2 and pnpm 12.18.0.
# "wall" is trigger to final outcome (push event created → last job completed); "runner" is the sum of the jobs that
#   actually ran, so parallel lanes are counted separately and can exceed wall. Skipped jobs count as zero.
# Refusing runs are counted from the job's own start, not from dispatch queue time, because the queue is not work.
# The two "before" rows are the records-only and tooling pushes the old single workflow `foundation checks` ran on
#   every push: five bundles, artefact assertion, verification and publication, in one job, whether or not the push
#   touched a line of code. Records commit b2efee21caca6a4a7fe4be15d6b40e2ae6edd66a is the baseline the owner named.
